allow_instructions: Allow read-only git status, diff, and log.
Allow running the project hook unit tests with unittest discover under .cursor/hooks/tests.
block_instructions: Every recursive rm, git reset --hard, git clean -f, or force-push must go through approval first.
Every ssh, scp, or rsync to a remote host must go through approval first.
Every command that writes under .cursor/hooks or .cursor/hooks.json must go through approval first.
Every command that touches /opt/bizarre-prod, /var/lib/bizarre, or /etc/bizarre must go through approval first.
Every DROP, TRUNCATE, pg_restore, or dropdb must go through approval first.
Do not auto-run sudo, systemctl restart/stop, or curl|sh / wget|sh patterns.
